description: Database view exposing user level mapping data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report user level mapping records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the user level mapping view.

columns.name: dashboard
columns.description: Dashboard of the user level mapping.

business_rules: Vw_UserLevelMapping is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.

known_issues: Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_UserLevelMapping (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
